token.description: Create a fine-grained GitHub PAT for an account other than the PO, limited to this repository: Metadata Read; Contents, Pull requests and Issues Read and write; Workflows Read and write only if editing .github/workflows; organization Projects Read and write (ADR-0043 Decision 4).

name.description: Git author name of the worker account; choose its GitHub display name.

email.description: Git author email of the worker account; copy its verified or GitHub noreply email from GitHub Settings > Emails.

gitUser.description: Git commit identity for the worker account.

github.description: One shared GitHub worker account; obtain its PAT in GitHub Settings > Developer settings > Fine-grained tokens.

id.description: Choose a unique profile name, e.g. codex-main; also names its private auth store.

tool.description: Select Claude Code for this profile.

type.description: Use token for a Claude subscription profile.

token.description: Run claude setup-token for this account: a 1-year token with user:inference scope. Rotate yearly; never paste it into prompts or logs.

auth.description: Claude authentication; obtain a separate setup-token for each profile.

id.description: Choose a unique profile name, e.g. codex-main; also names its private auth store.

tool.description: Select Codex with a ChatGPT plan for this profile.

type.description: Run omi profile login <id> once from Windows PowerShell. Codex stores rotating ChatGPT refresh credentials only in its writable profile store, never here.

auth.description: Codex ChatGPT subscription login; no static token or API key.

profiles.description: Worker accounts; choose unique IDs and authenticate each with its tool.

docker.description: Enables the project Docker runtime; omit to retain the existing WSL binding.

container.description: Docker container name; defaults to omi-<repo>.

image.description: Locally built image tag; defaults to omi-worker:<framework-version>.

memory.description: Docker memory limit, e.g. 8g; defaults to 8g.

memoryWarningPercent.description: Doctor memory warning threshold, percent; default 80.
